summary: Quiet Hunter Street kerb with homes 12-17 m away on both sides.

drivers.seclusion: Detached houses 12-17 m away on the north side and across the road; no bush or park.
drivers.access_and_room: Kerbside parking lane; other cars park along it, room for a van.
drivers.traffic: Quiet residential street with local traffic.
drivers.convention: Cars park along kerb both sides; 7am-12 noon Mon-Fri no-parking signs.

flags: Weekday morning no-parking signs, no-stopping near the east end
Steepens to about 8% east of 35 m
sun_shade: Mostly open; tree shade on the northern side from the north-west.

best_section.where: Hunter Street north kerb, about 15 m east of the western ring
